digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: There is no aggregation layer to surface how agent-driven dev loops trend over time across recorded event-sourced history

Agent-lifecycle signals (env/integration-diagnosis time, bug provenance, replanning classification) and code-health metrics (coverage/complexity/clone) leave no durable trace in the event store and cannot be queried structurally

The rebar metrics command must derive metrics structurally from the event store where signals have clean signatures, and emit passive instrumentation only for tier-C blindspots (diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug classification) stamped by trustworthy code rather than agent self-report

Bug provenance auto-derivation via blame must respect closed-source guards by writing causality edges directly when the bug is already closed, skip derivation when file_impact is ambiguous or blame cannot resolve, and allow explicit --caused-by overrides to always win

Bug-close friction must not increase: the required free-text --reason argument is replaced (not supplemented) by a bounded --class enum persisted on STATUS events, with backfilled historical values labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified

The metrics command must emit a date-range aggregation with every registered metric present carrying source and confidence fields, report unavailable metrics with structured reason and accruing_since, and reuse existing surfaces (gate sidecars, transition command, link relations) without introducing new event types
